(PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1.

By means of the present petition, the petitioner seeks to challenge the notification dated 19.05.2023 published under Section 10A of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, "the Act' 2013").

sentences.text: for which exemption is granted vide notification dated 19.05.2023.

However, the fact remains that the acquisition proceedings in furtherance of the notification dated 19.05.2023 have already been proceeded with the publication of the notification under Sections 11 and 19 of the Act' 2013, after submission of the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/10995/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/08/2025 undefined report by the Collector under Section 15 (2) of the Act' 2013, as is clear from the averments made in the writ petition.

2. The further statement in the writ petition that the petitioner was called under Section 21 for hearing and made claims in writing yet, no payment has been made and no final notification under Section 23 of the Act has been published, is clear proof of the fact that the proceedings had been continued till the stage of Section 15(2) of the Act' 2013.

3. In these facts and circumstances brought on record, the petitioner cannot be permitted to challenge the notifications dated 19.05.2023, without bringing correct and complete facts on record and making appropriate prayer.
4. At this stage, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and is granted permission to withdraw the present petition with a liberty to file a fresh with better particulars.
